r: In this role you will manage customer projects, according to defined Project Management (PM) standards and customer requirements and you will have responsibility for economic results. You will:
Manage single- and multiple Substation Control System (SCS) /SCADA solution projects.
Lead all phases of assigned projects—from planning to execution and final closeout.
Manage the cost, schedule, quality, and technical performance of the assigned project(s).
Define project milestones and ensure alignment with master plans and timelines.
Communicate expectations, updates, risks, and progress clearly to leadership, and customers.
Lead and drive multi-disciplinary and cross functional teams, including engineering, operations, vendor management, logistics and services to ensure successful project execution.
Provide routine status reports covering scope, budget, schedule, and performance.
On a regular basis, informing customers, management, project team and additional interested parties (Stakeholders) of the project status.
Carry out Risk Identification and Mitigation.
Monitor cash-flow planning and activate appropriate escalation procedures.
Handle customer expectations throughout the entire project lifecycle.
Conduct diagnostics to resolve root causes and implement corrective actions.
Coordinate overall planning of the project and decide on allocation of resources.
Develop strategies to continue and/or reinforce engagements to the customer.
Ensure strong proposal and contract management on the project. Evaluating impacts of changed requirements/ delivery items regarding costs, project plan etc.
Monitor milestone and adherence to budgets and initiate actions to minimize non-conformance cost. Maintain constant communication with customers, outside contractors or other stakeholders.
May coordinate agreed commissioning measures onsite, together with Service team.
Adhere to PM standards and Business Conduct Guidelines (e.g. Tax regulations, Export Control, EHS).
Manage and coordinate all temporarily assigned project staff.
Manage the Project completion/ close out and the acceptance of delivery units and services incl. validation and verification and organize the finalized handover to the customer and involved parties.

r: Participate in management meetings with the site management to keep them updated on HSE matters
Participate in the investigations for HSE incidents
Implement the Hazard Reporting, Action Tracking Register and Scorecard for the site.
Implement HSE Management Systems and procedures on site.
Prepare Risk Assessments and recommend corrective actions.
Conduct routine inspections related to (scaffolding / electrical / cranes etc.)
Inspect the fire fighting and protection equipment in the plant
Ensure positive relation with the clients’ HSE team.
Resolve any complaints from the client related to HSE issues.
